svg.title: One command = fork, exec, wait (and everything is inherited)
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “One command = fork, exec, wait (and everything is inherited)” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A shell command box above the six things the shell does before your program starts. To the right, the parent process forks a child, an arrow trying to send an environment change back up is crossed out in red, and the child's three inherited file descriptors show only stdout redirected to a file. Below, the nine permission bits are drawn as a three-by-three grid mapping rwxr-x--- to octal 750, and the child's exit status 1 returns to the parent as dollar-question-mark.
svg.text: One command = fork, exec, wait (and everything is inherited)
draw it from memory, then compare
